title: Elastic Size Misfit at Its Physical Ceiling: a Ta(Lu) Probe for Solid Solution Softening in bcc Metals
description: Multiscale pipeline (Stroh anisotropic elasticity, semi-grand-canonical atmosphere sampling, solid-on-solid kink-pair kinetic Monte Carlo, and VASP/QE input generators for 39 pre-specified DFT calculations) accompanying a preregistered test of whether statistical elastic disorder is sufficient to cause solid solution softening in bcc Ta. v2.0 adds the full manuscript in English and Chinese with LaTeX sources, a CSV data layer from which every figure is regenerated, vector figures, and a bibliography in which all 18 entries were checked against publisher records (nine errors corrected). Archived at the preregistration stage: no DFT results exist in this release; run verify_no_results.sh to confirm the output templates are empty.
